utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — what time are we aiming for, and should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s aim for 8:15 sharp, and just bring your usual bag. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, 8:15 works for me. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the pickup time and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll text you the pickup time once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, are we still doing the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — I just want to make sure the timing still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m happy to help; just tell me what time and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — can you be at my place at 7:30, and we’ll head out from there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:30 at your place works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the pickup time and the exact address before I say yes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m sorry, I don’t have the pickup time or exact address yet. I’ll check and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — just send the time and address when you have them, and I’ll confirm then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m probably gonna be a little late again—can I still hop in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, no problem — just give me a heads-up when you’re close, and we’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — I’ll text you when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you cover the pickup on Tuesday and Thursday this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I can cover the pickup on Tuesday and Thursday this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — who’s picking up, and what time should I mark down?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do pickup today — let’s say 3:15 at the school gate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve marked you down for pickup at 3:15 by the school gate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might start as early as next week—want me to check what time everyone’s aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please—if you can check, that’d be great. I’ll spread the word once we know the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and see what time folks are leaning toward. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you still do the carpool this week, or do we need to make other arrangements?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can still do it this week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what time should I be ready each day?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with everyone about the carpool and let you know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll circle back once I’ve asked everyone and we’ll lock in the carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the carpool list organized—want me to check your pickup time or make any changes?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa—could you just check my pickup time? I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll check it right now and let you know your pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Eli — I heard the carpool might start earlier this week because of traffic. Want me to check who’s driving?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do. I’d appreciate a clear plan as soon as you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get you a clear plan as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — is the carpool still open?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s still open — we’re leaving in a few minutes. I’ll repeat the plan to everyone now so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’m in. Just let me know where to meet and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Could you take the Tuesday morning shift this week?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can take Tuesday morning this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what time do you need me for carpool?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll need you at 7:30 sharp by the front curb.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, 7:30 by the front curb works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can help line up the carpool. What time are you thinking, and who still needs a ride?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could we aim for 7:30, and I need to confirm whether Mia and Ben still need rides?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — 7:30 works for me. I can check with Mia and Ben, and then we’ll know who still needs a spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the carpool. What time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I was thinking we could meet at 7:45 so we’ve got a little buffer before school.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 7:45 works for me—I’ll try to be on time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the carpool looking this week?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Looks pretty good so far — I’ve got my spot covered, and I can lend the cooler or a booster seat if anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that helps a lot. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and days were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Weekdays are best — could you do a 7:30 pickup?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 7:30 works for me on weekdays.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join the carpool, but I’d like to know the pickup time and route first so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — we usually leave at 7:30 and take Maple to Oak, then over to the school. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should work, thanks — I just need to make sure I’m ready a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the carpool if you want in—happy to save you a seat!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate a seat. Just let me know the pickup time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll swing by at 7:15, and I’ll text you if that changes. Glad to have you in the carpool!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — what time are you thinking for pickup, and who’s dropping off?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I’m thinking around 7:30 pickup, and I can do the drop-off if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7:30 works for me — I can handle pickup if you’ve got drop-off covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the carpool organized. What days and times are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve been hearing it’s mostly weekday mornings, but I’m not sure which exact days yet. I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — just send me the days when you know them, and I’ll help sort out the schedule.
